name: questly-submission
description: Questly monorepo: Fastify API and Next.js UI

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
